scripts.install-pods-no-hermes: cd ios && bundle exec env USE_HERMES=NO pod install && cd ..
scripts.clean-codepush: rm -rf codepush && mkdir codepush && mkdir codepush/android && mkdir codepush/ios
scripts.bundle-ios: yarn clean-codepush && node node_modules/.bin/react-native bundle --platform ios --entry-file index.js --bundle-output ./codepush/ios/main.jsbundle --assets-dest ./codepush/ios --dev false --reset-cache
scripts.bundle-android: yarn clean-codepush && node node_modules/.bin/react-native bundle --platform android --entry-file index.js --bundle-output ./codepush/android/index.android.bundle --assets-dest ./codepush/android --dev false --reset-cache
scripts.codepush:prod:ios: yarn bundle-ios && appcenter codepush release-react -a app_team/Nova-ios -d Production-Appstore -m -t 1.0.9
scripts.codepush:prod:android: yarn bundle-android && appcenter codepush release-react -a app_team/Nova-android -d Production -m -t 1.0.9
scripts.codepush:staging:ios: APP_ENV=stag yarn bundle-ios && appcenter codepush release-react -a app_team/Nova-ios -d Staging -m -t 1.0.9
scripts.codepush:staging:android: APP_ENV=stag yarn bundle-android && appcenter codepush release-react -a app_team/Nova-android -d Staging -m -t 1.0.9
